items.name: #28 "The Wellerman"
items.region: Listed under Principe by the page; earned via the Restored Yellowed Map
items.where: Hardest sheet. Rebuild the Treasure Dealer at the Great Inagua docks (available in Sequence 4); the Restored Yellowed Map hunt gives it.
items.gate: Needs 10 Yellowed Map Pieces and 100 Aloe. Pieces are random rewards from schooner trade missions in Kenway's Fleet (tip: save before accepting fleet reports and reload to reroll). Aloe sometimes comes from fleet piracy missions in the southwest.

notes: Page lists all 28. Entry 28 is grouped under Principe by the page but is earned via the Restored Yellowed Map (treasure at Black Island per the treasure map page). Reward for 28 is not explicitly stated.
